payload.title: typeorm_entity_schema_forbidden and tests/invariants/entity-schema-declaration.spec.ts both judge ADR-011's per-tenant-must-omit-schema direction with different cross-tenant criteria and different service lists, and no test compares their verdicts
evidence: tools/aria-adapters/typeorm-entity-schema-adapter.ts:435-440 (forbidden fires when a schema is declared, the service is tenant-scoped and the table is not in infrastructureTables; infrastructureTables is the only cross-tenant criterion)
tests/invariants/entity-schema-declaration.spec.ts:299-311 (the repo gate also treats an entity as cross-tenant when its file name matches CROSS_TENANT_FILENAME_PATTERNS)
tests/invariants/entity-schema-declaration.spec.ts:331-338 (the gate's own forbidden verdict, a regex presence test on the decorator arguments)
tests/invariants/entity-schema-declaration.spec.ts:75-83 (the gate's tenant-scoped service list is an inline hand copy, not TENANT_SCOPED_MODULES which the adapter reads)
tests/invariants/entity-schema-declaration.spec.ts:120-150 (the filename pattern list the adapter does not read)
tools/aria-adapters/typeorm-entity-schema-adapter.forbidden.test.ts:193-197 (the only pin of the adapter's verdict reads the live tree alone; nothing runs it beside the repo gate)
tests/invariants/tenant-fanout-entity-parity.spec.ts:112-115 (names tenant-schema-routing.architecture.spec.ts as another gate of this direction; that file no longer exists at this revision)
payload.rule_violated: ADR-011 per-table schema discipline (root CLAUDE.md CRITICAL block); CLAUDE.md tier 3 (make it detectable): two readers of one rule need a test that fails when they disagree
payload.notes: The adapter classifies cross-tenant tables only by MODULE_SCHEMAS[].infrastructureTables; the repo gate also accepts any file whose name matches a cross-tenant pattern and keeps its own list of tenant-scoped services. An hr entity file named like *-audit.entity.ts that declares schema: 'hr' while its table is absent from infrastructureTables passes the gate (line 299 makes shouldDeclareSchema true) and is reported HIGH by the adapter. A service added to TENANT_SCOPED_MODULES is judged by the adapter but skipped by the gate's hand list (line 288 continues when the service has no map entry). Both are green on the current tree (adapter baseline pin 0, gate green), so the first disagreement appears as a SHADOW finding with no test saying which reader is right. Close condition: Add one test that runs analyzeTypeOrmEntities over the live apps tree and the repo gate's classification over the same entity files and asserts they name the same set of per-tenant entities that declare schema (empty today), or make the gate read TENANT_SCOPED_MODULES and infrastructureTables through the same reader; closed when that test fails after a per-tenant entity is made to declare schema in only one of the two judges. Plan row: DET detector program (landing batch 2b). Verified at head b2259fe03f of open pull request #2151; the cited code is not on main until that pull request merges.
